text:
Silver Price in 2008
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2008, the LBMA silver price fell 35.5% between 2008-01-31 ($16.74) and 2008-12-31 ($10.79). The highest sampled price was $19.62 in February and the lowest was $9.28 in October. The mean of these observations was $14.98. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2008:
The global financial crisis drove waves of safe-haven demand into precious metals.
